notes.title: Hotfix 1 is live
notes.content:
Updated the traction for the muscle car, it now grips properly to surfaces but can still turn rapidly to avoid affecting gameplay too much.

The reversing speed on the Muscle car was also slowed down for better control when recovering etc.

Thanks for the feedback everyone!
